reading.body:
Evoque Allen DA1 is a facility in Allen, Texas, operated by Centersquare. The operator has not published a power capacity figure for this campus. Without a published specification, its size relative to other AI infrastructure cannot be determined from operator claims.

Texas has 133 mapped data center facilities, of which 18 publish power capacity totaling 468 MW. This campus does not appear in the ranked list of published capacity, placing it outside the top 18 in the state. Whether it hosts AI infrastructure depends on specifications the operator has not disclosed.

The campus exists as a verified physical location. Determining whether it matters to AI scaling requires published power capacity, power quality certifications, and cooling specifications that are not on record.
